1. **Shape.** Draft PR to `main`, `Fixes #32854`. 4 files, +212/−10 = 222 lines ≤ 3000; `check-governed-merges --pr 32963`: NOT governed. Changeset `.changeset/32854-snapshot-file-fields.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`); no i18n key, no export; contract review not owed. Files within claim 6839932340. Body patched by the seat: seat-opinion line, signed trailer.
2. **Premise, measured.** Held on `main` `a888c5c9` (claim). The card thread measured that the submitted snapshot holds stored `sys_file` ids, opened through the existing `/api/v1/storage/files/ID` endpoint, so no server change and no new download channel.
3. **Review.** The per-kind rule (triage 6838260478: an in-lane design) is stated in `RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx`'s header and the PR body: media-family fields (`FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, already imported by five app-shell modules) are drawn through the field's own cell after the rows, outside the six-row cap; every other object or list value stays out. Rows still come from `shown` (permission-filtered), so a denied file field is not drawn.
4. **Gates.** Check-runs on this head: all success or skipped, 0 failure, at landing. Card thread: pins 36/36; ablation (object skip restored) reds 8 pins; dispatch-gates 36/36 exit 0 incl. `check-sdui-manifest`; app-shell type-check 0. Report 6840610166.
5. **Accepted deviations.** A single `file` field whose value is a string id used to show as a plain row (the id); it now shows as an attachment link. Intended by the rule.
6. **Out of scope / landing.** None filed. Ordinary queue landing: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` now, on the standing landing go-ahead for pm-dispatch-reviewed PRs (maintainer, 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-06). On MERGED: confirm #32854 closed, remove `pm:dispatched`.
